key_insight: Explainable deep reinforcement learning can optimize building battery operation while making the control policy understandable to users.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps reduce electricity costs in PV-equipped buildings by combining real-time measurements, forecasts, and tariff signals for smarter energy management.
method: Train on-policy and off-policy DRL agents for residential building control.
Use an expanded state space with demand, PV generation, battery state, weather, prices, and calendar features.
Apply post-hoc interpretation methods to explain learned control decisions.
evidence_signal: The study evaluates both synthetic data and real-world Living Lab Energy Campus data, and reports that A2C and PPO outperform off-policy methods in cumulative reward and policy stability.
watch_item: Results may depend on data quality, forecast accuracy, and the specific building setup, so transferability to other sites should be validated.
paper_title: Explainable Data-driven Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods for Optimal Energy Management in Buildings
